services.name: View Tour
services.desc: Explore the crystal-clear waters of Silver Springs in a clear kayak or paddleboard, guided by one of our experienced local experts. Spot wildlife up close-including alligators, turtles, birds, and more-while gliding through one of Florida’s most beautiful natural environments. View Florida’s beautiful Alligators safely from your clear Kayak or Paddleboard with our expert guides! Is it safe?? Yes! The Gators at Silver Springs are very happy and docile in their natural habitat. Our guides are experts at alligator behavior and will guide you past them safely. We’ll even get photos for you. services.name: Clear Kayak Tours in Orlando
services.desc: Fewer things are more relaxing than being on the water at night time. Enjoy a glass of sparkling wine, the setting sun and city lights on this peaceful paddle through Lake Ivanhoe in a Clear Kayak or Clear Paddleboard. Our Night Glow Paddle Tour is a beautiful and unique view of the gorgeous clear water in Lake Ivanhoe. These incredibly powerful multi-color LED lights reflect the brilliant colors below you. Choose your favorite color and enjoy a leisurely night tour. This experience just north of downtown Orlando is the best view of the City Beautiful. There are no gators on this lake, so no worries. services.name: Paddleboard rental
services.desc: Discover Orlando’s historic and scenic Lake Ivanhoe by paddleboard or clear kayak. A fun, beginner-friendly adventure perfect for families and first-time paddlers. We are even pet friendly! Please note that we do not see manatees on this lake. We love beginners and first-timeers just getting into paddleboarding and kayaking. 95% of our guests have never paddled before and our guides are very experienced and trained to help everyone learn to have a good time. With clear kayaks and clear paddleboards in our fleet, we have one of the most unique experiences in Orlando.
